finding: Supabase CLI 2.119.0 renders migration-list version cells with surrounding backticks. The exact-drift parser accepted only bare 14-digit cells, so valid rows were discarded before any production mutation.
fix: Normalize surrounding backticks and whitespace before parsing local/remote migration versions.
invariants: Pre-repair drift must remain exactly the four reviewed local-only replay baselines.
Remote-only or identity drift remains fail-closed.
Only official supabase migration repair --status applied --db-url may mutate production migration tracking.
